//: Self-contained config for emitting consumer-facing type declarations (dist/). Runs during `prepare` for git-dependency consumers and before npm publish; not used by Nx builds inside the monorepo (those resolve src/ via tsconfig paths). Emit is intentionally tolerant: declaration files are emitted even if type errors are reported, because consumers compile against these declarations with skipLibCheck. prepare therefore succeeds iff dist/index.d.ts exists.
